We need to output JSON with lesson and final_answer. Lesson: key distinguishing feature: theft of telecom cable is theft, not just damage. Also includes destruction of broadcast TV facilities? Actually correct label includes "破坏广播电视设施、公用电气设施;盗窃". The case involves theft of telecom cable, which is both theft and damage to telecom facilities. The wrong prediction only labeled "破坏公用电信设施". Need to note that theft of cable is separate theft crime. Also include broadcast TV facilities? The case mentions telecom cable, not broadcast TV. But correct label includes both broadcast TV facilities and telecom facilities. Possibly because telecom cable also considered broadcast TV? Anyway lesson: differentiate between "破坏" (damage) vs "盗窃" (theft). If the act involves taking property (stealing cable), charge theft in addition to damage. Provide rule: If the conduct includes removal/appropriation of telecom cable for personal gain, label includes 盗窃; if only damage without appropriation, label is 破坏公用电信设施.

Now produce JSON.
